newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone coup leaders set up looting hotlines.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone coup leaders set up looting hotlines.

text.p: Sierra Leone's new military authorities on Thursday set up two telephone hotlines for the public to complain about harassment and looting.

Sierra Leoneans can call 272086 for the military police, and 272734 for army headquarters, though it is not clear how many will take the risk of reporting looting which witnesses say is carried out mainly by soldiers.

"The public is now informed that telephone hotlines have been installed to address all complaints regarding harassment, looting, and any distress suffered or required security assistance," said a defence headquarters statement broadcast by Sierra Leone radio.

"The AFRC (Armed Forces Revolutionary Council) is appealing to all Sierra Leoneans to cooperate with the Army to restore peace, law, and order in our beloved country," the statement said. "Your complaints will be thoroughly investigated."
Junior military officers seized control in Freetown on Sunday and overthrew the elected government of President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah.
